data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/entity-schema.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/schemas/<Entity>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Requires the fields map; description optional. Per-field shape (type, widget, readonly, …) is validated permissively here and rigorously by the runtime validator.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0

title: Spec 60 — schemas/<Entity>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS entity schema file (e.g. manifests/gmail/schemas/Message.yaml) after _meta is stripped. The fields map is required.

fields.description: Map of field name (e.g. Subject, To) → field definition. Each entry must have type; widget/primary/readonly/required/picklist are optional.

widget.description: Widget id used to read/write this field (e.g. gmail.compose_to_input).
